title: A congressman on the progress of reverse engineering programs

plain: An unnamed congressman says he believes secret programs exist to reverse engineer recovered craft, meaning to take them apart and learn how to build them, but he doubts they are working. Asked about it on the show, he answers "Yeah, I do," then adds that he thinks "they're going to scrap it," because "if they had it, we would own the skies."
